AboutProject.title: About This Project
AboutProject.description: AURA // EDITOR is a modern, high-performance OpenAPI specification tool designed for the next generation of web services. It provides a real-time validation environment, schema visualization, and interactive documentation, all wrapped in a sleek, minimalist interface inspired by futuristic tech aesthetics.
